sentences.text: Honeymoon is the fourth studio album and third major-label record by American singer and songwriter Lana Del Rey .	Lana Del Rey	Lana Del Rey	studio album	studio album

It was released on September 18 , 2015 , by Polydor Records and Interscope Records , and was produced by Del Rey alongside longtime collaborators Rick Nowels and Kieron Menzies .	Interscope	Interscope Records	Polydor	Polydor Records	Rick Nowels	Rick Nowels	Polydor Records	Polydor Records	Interscope Records	Interscope Records

The album is , stylistically , described as a departure from the rock-oriented music of Del Rey 's previous album Ultraviolence and a return to the baroque pop of Born to Die and Paradise .	Ultraviolence	Ultraviolence (album)	Born to Die	Born to Die (Lana Del Rey album)	Paradise	Paradise (Lana Del Rey EP)
Lyrically , the album touches on themes of tortured romance , bitterness , lust , escapism , and violence .	romance	romance (love)	bitterness	resentment	lust	lust	escapism	escapism	violence	violence
Upon release , Honeymoon received positive reviews from music critics , appearing on the 2015 best albums lists of many publications .
Many critics consider the album Del Rey 's best album to date .
The album debuted at number two on the US Billboard 200 , selling 116,000 units in first week , and peaking at number one in Australia , Greece and Ireland .
The album was supported by the release of two singles : `` High by the Beach '' , and `` Music to Watch Boys To '' .	High by the Beach	High by the Beach	Music to Watch Boys To	Music to Watch Boys To
